sources.application: sub_599335 splits dynamic levels at DYN_UPG_LV using the native base LEVEL. sub_599417 adds both products: XP_KILLED at 0x59955C..0x59956C; XP_NEXT at 0x59956F..0x5995A6. The table fields are loaded at 0x597EAE/0x597EC1 and read via 0x597F5B/0x597F5F.

implementation: Native heroes and other units use the same additive early/late XP_KILLED growth; the rounded x1.1 hero recurrence is removed.
All 356 catalogue records now retain both XP_NEXT increments as growth.required_early and growth.required_late. The catalogue importer reads them directly from GDynUpgr.
Both XP lookups cover levels 0..99 on the device. required_xp and experience share these values with battle XP banks, promotions, trainers, observations and manual play.
The existing level-99 promotion/training lock is retained; 98 -> 99 remains legal.
The explicit Super Last Stand exp_increment override replaces only early XP_NEXT growth. Native late growth still applies. Native catalogue rows no longer contain this override.
The standalone guardian planner's threshold cost arithmetic follows both XP_NEXT stages. It was not run.
Duke fixture combat statistics retain their original reference provenance; only XP values and the supported level range were updated from original-game sources.
